messages:
emma: Quick UX sync: re: spend breakdown card \u2014 should token counts appear next to amounts or inside a hover panel? prototyped both.
santiago: Inline token counts help scanning but add clutter. Hover panel keeps visual weight on $ value.
claire: For compliance customers, tokens-per-call are important. Maybe show summary inline (e.g., 12.3k tokens) and move per-route details to hover/expand.
emma: Good point. What about responsive behavior: show tokens inline on >=1024px, hide to hover on mobile?
santiago: yes. Also add a small info icon with tooltip: 'Token counts are approximate and rounded'.
claire: Accessibility: ensure info icon is focusable and tooltip announced (aria-describedby).
dev-bot: New figma frame: https://figma.com/file/xyz789 updated by @emma.
emma: Copy tweak: "Tokens (approx.)" vs "Token count" 5: which?
santiago: "Tokens (approx.)" reads clearer.
claire: one more nit: chart area needs aria-label that includes scope (org/project) and date range.
emma: I'll update the prototype: inline summary on desktop, hover/expand on mobile, token label 'Tokens (approx.)', tooltip accessible, and aria-label enhancements. Move to dev backlog after review.
santiago: +1
claire: +1
